svg.title: CommitAtlas: public evidence to deterministic cards (animated)
svg.desc: Animated loop: the Worker fetches a credential-free public GitHub snapshot, and the evidence model labels source, window and freshness. A deterministic contribution card fills week by week. When the upstream returns 502, the last-good card is kept but visibly marked stale, then refreshes on recovery. The Action renders dark and light bundles with a SHA-256 manifest for embedding in a profile README.
svg.text: credential-free public evidence · explicit source, window, freshness · stale is shown as stale · no rankings
source: public GraphQL · fresh 2 min · sha256 3fa1…
source: public GraphQL · fresh 0 min · sha256 3fa1…
no rank · no productivity score · no private inference

g.text: → profile README embeds the exact bytes

svg.text: The Worker fetches a public snapshot. No token, no private data
Every reading carries its source, window and freshness, and says what is unavailable
The card renders deterministically, week by week
Upstream fails: the last-good card is kept but marked STALE, never painted healthy
On recovery the card is fresh again
The Action renders dark and light bundles from one fetch
A SHA-256 manifest proves the exact bytes your README embeds
